inspection.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] {r : ℕ} (f : QuarticQuery.PartialBool κ)
  (ν : Fin r → QuarticQuery.BitInput κ → ℝ) (c : Fin r → ℕ),
  (∀ (h : Fin r) (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput κ), 0 ≤ ν h x) →
    ∀ (s : Fin r → Bool),
      QuarticQuery.guessSuccess f (fun h => QuarticQuery.Paper.classicalLaw (ν h)) (QuarticQuery.OutTree.leaf s) ≤
          ∏ h,
            Max.max (QuarticQuery.constSuccess f (QuarticQuery.Paper.classicalLaw (ν h)) Bool.false)
              (QuarticQuery.constSuccess f (QuarticQuery.Paper.classicalLaw (ν h)) Bool.true) ∧
        ∏ h,
            Max.max (QuarticQuery.constSuccess f (QuarticQuery.Paper.classicalLaw (ν h)) Bool.false)
              (QuarticQuery.constSuccess f (QuarticQuery.Paper.classicalLaw (ν h)) Bool.true) ≤
          QuarticQuery.Paper.classicalProductValue f ν c

lean.note: The conclusion contains both product inequalities: correctness of a fixed vector at the leaf is bounded by the product of the best constant guesses, itself by the product of continuation values. For an actual positive transcript instantiate ν with transcript-restricted weights, c with remaining caps, and use product law.
